text:
I need to find Luigina Giavotti's age when she won her silver medal in gymnastics at the 1928 Olympics.

Luigina Giavotti was born on October 5, 1916, and competed at the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics. The gymnastics competition took place in August 1928.

From October 5, 1916 to August 1928 would make her 11 years old. More precisely, if the competition was in early-to-mid August 1928, she would have been 11 years and approximately 9-10 months old (about 306-316 days before her 12th birthday on October 5, 1928).

The most commonly cited age is 11 years and 302 days.

Answer: 11 years and 302 days
Confidence: 0.85
